subject: general
question: The radius of a cylinder is 7 feet. Find the total surface area of the cylinder if the height of the cylinder is 14 feet. (Use π = 22/7)
solution:
**Given:**

Radius of the cylinder (r) = 7 feet

Height of the cylinder (h) = 14 feet

π = 22/7

**Formula used:**

Total Surface Area of a Cylinder = 2πr(r + h)

**Calculations:**

Total Surface Area = 2 × (22/7) × 7 × (7 + 14)

⇒ Total Surface Area = 2 × 22 × (7 + 14)

⇒ Total Surface Area = 44 × 21

⇒ Total Surface Area = 924 square feet

**∴ The total surface area of the cylinder is 924 square feet.**
